fields.description: Tria is a three-wing residential development in Dubai Silicon Oasis. Deyaar announced its handover on 6 October 2026, describing 711 residences and six retail units. The housing mix extends from studios to three-bedroom apartments, duplexes, podium townhouses and penthouses.
